ai.title: Fix empty multi-select response via undefined stripping
ai.summary: Multi-select answers now omit `selectedOptions` when skipped, preventing `undefined` in JSON payloads. Added `removeUndefinedValues` in `cli/src/utils/codebuff-client.ts` to recursively strip undefined keys before serialization. Updates `cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx` to return only `questionIndex` for empty arrays.

eli5.text: When you skip a multi-select question instead of choosing options, the assistant no longer sends an incomplete answer that could confuse the system. You won't notice anything different in how you interact, but behind the scenes the assistant now leaves out the empty selection rather than sending a broken response.

ai.title: Code search includes hidden config directories by default
ai.summary: Code search now automatically scans hidden directories like .agents, .github, and .claude alongside standard project files. The tool passes these paths explicitly to the underlying ripgrep process, ensuring agent definitions and CI workflows are discoverable without manual flag configuration. Missing directories are ignored by ripgrep, preventing errors. This change affects the sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts implementation.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to search your project's code, it will now automatically look inside commonly used configuration folders that it used to skip, such as ones holding workflow rules and agent settings. Those folders were already part of your project; you just had to tell the search to look in them manually, and now it does that for you as a default. If you search for something, you may notice it now also finds matches stored in those folders, instead of only the main folders the tool used to check first.

ai.title: CLI bash tool results and exit status preservation
ai.summary: CLI now handles bash tool results directly, preserving exit status and routing queued messages through the command router. New `PendingBashMessage` state and `addBashMessageToHistory` logic in `router.ts` enable immediate placeholder display and asynchronous output updates. `MessageBlock` renders bash metadata (cwd, timestamp) separately from standard user messages. `use-send-message.ts` injects `pendingToolResults` into `client.run` via `extraToolResults`, ensuring AI context continuity for user-executed commands.

eli5.text: When you run a command in the CLI chat, the result now appears immediately as a placeholder and updates asynchronously once the command finishes, instead of waiting and replacing the whole message. The CLI treats your bash command output as regular chat context, so the AI can see what you ran (including the working directory and timing) right away. If you’re watching the terminal, you’ll notice commands show a live status and their output flows into the conversation without freezing the chat. This is live today for CLI users.

ai.title: CLI bash ghost UI with dashed box and batch flush
ai.summary: CLI bash execution adds ephemeral ghost messages rendered with a dashed border box in `cli/src/components/pending-bash-message.tsx` via `TerminalCommandDisplay`. Completed commands batch-flush to chat history instead of removing individually, fixing UI jitter during rapid execution. `executeBashCommand` in `cli/src/commands/router.ts` now accepts a `ghost` flag to toggle between direct history insertion and pending state management. `formatCwd` extracted to `cli/src/utils/path-helpers.ts` for shared use.

eli5.text: When you run a command in the CLI, it now shows a dashed, ghost-like preview that stays on screen while the command runs instead of flickering in and out. Finished commands are added to the chat history all at once in a single smooth update rather than one at a time. This makes the terminal feel steadier and less jumpy when you trigger several commands quickly. The change is live today in the CLI.
